title: Fail-closed Meta WhatsApp hub signature and verify-token admission before any PostEntry/PG
problem: Meta POST admission treats verifyMetaHubSignature256 skipped:true as allow. That includes (1) absent META_APP_SECRET and (2) present secret with missing X-Hub-Signature-256. Committed staging/sunset Bicep never wire META_APP_SECRET, so deployments from those manifests inherit fail-open POST. GET hub verify also falls back to a hardcoded default token.

required_controls.detail: When META_APP_SECRET is empty, verifyMetaHubSignature256 must not return skipped:true that the HTTP handler admits. Prefer verified:false skipped:false with a stable error (e.g. app_secret_unconfigured) and HTTP 503/403 with no_write_performed before PostEntry.

When META_APP_SECRET is set and X-Hub-Signature-256 is missing/empty, return skipped:false verified:false (missing_signature_header) so handleMetaWhatsAppWebhookPost rejects 403. Never map missing header to skipped:true.
HTTP gate must reject unless verified:true (or an explicit, profile-gated META_WEBHOOK_SKIP_VERIFY-style flag analogous to Stripe — default false, refused in staging/production profiles).
resolveMetaWhatsAppVerifyToken must not succeed with DEFAULT_META_WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN in staging/production profiles. Require META_WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN from env or fail closed on GET.
Declare META_APP_SECRET (and META_WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN) via Key Vault secretRef on staging and sunset Staff API Bicep, parallel to stripe-webhook-secret. Do not commit secret values.

acceptance_tests: RED: META_APP_SECRET unset + POST body → 403/503; signature_verification_skipped must not allow PostEntry; acquired_pg false
RED: META_APP_SECRET set + missing X-Hub-Signature-256 → 403; no PostEntry/PG
RED: META_APP_SECRET set + wrong sha256 → 403; no PostEntry/PG
RED: GET hub verify with unset META_WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN under staging/production profile → 403 (no hardcoded default admit)
GREEN: META_APP_SECRET set + valid sha256=HMAC → admit to PostEntry path (authority/DB gates unchanged)
GREEN: GET with matching META_WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN still returns hub.challenge
GREEN: historical 15A B01 unproven verdict unchanged; 15K overlay + 15L remediation overlay only
out_of_scope: B12 Stripe webhook signature behavior change (residual skip footgun optional follow-up)
live Meta / Azure / Key Vault secret rotation execution
Hermes WhatsApp verify token cutover on Lunabox
must_not: treat skipped:true as HTTP admit for Meta POST
commit real META_APP_SECRET or verify token values
enable a Meta skip-verify flag without staging/production refuse
